2014_spells.hail-of-thorns.description: The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack before this spell ends, this spell creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your ranged weapon or ammunition. In addition to the normal effects of the attack, the target of the attack and each creature within 5 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 1d10 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
2014_spells.hail-of-thorns.effectSummary: Deal 1d10 piercing damage to a target within Self
2014_spells.hail-of-thorns.fullDescripti: Using 1 bonus action, the next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack before this spell ends, this spell creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your ranged weapon or ammunition. In addition to the normal effects of the attack, the target of the attack and each creature within 5 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d20, add the DEX modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; A creature takes 1d10 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one; If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the piercing damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st (to a maximum of 6d10). The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack before this spell ends, this spell creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your ranged weapon or ammunition; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
